fr.title: Freshness

fr.log.title: Log
fr.log.say: Every import and processing run – without amounts or account numbers.
fr.log.empty: No entries yet. The next import will show up here.
fr.valid.title: Do the months add up?
fr.valid.say: Per account and month: the balance change between first and last reading must match the bookings.
fr.valid.empty: Not checkable yet – it needs at least two balance readings on different days of a month.

fr.deriv.title: Is anything lost while evaluating?
fr.deriv.ok: No. All $n bookings flowed completely into categories and transfers.
fr.deriv.bad: Yes: $diff differ ($ledger bookings stored, $derived evaluated). "Refresh" rebuilds everything from the stored raw data.
fr.nonadmin: Only an administrator sees import and check details.
ov.import.tip: Fetches raw data from the bank and processes it. Does not count against the automatic limit.
ov.reprocess.tip: Re-processes the stored raw data. No bank call.
ov.reprocess.empty: No stored raw data yet — "Import again" fetches it from the bank.
ov.reprocess.unavailable: Refreshing is not possible right now (no raw archive).
ov.reprocess.error: Refreshing failed — the previous data is kept.
fr.valid.gaps_one: One month has a gap. Usually bookings from before the first import are missing.
setup.title: Setup
setup.load_error: The setup could not be loaded.
setup.admin_only: An administrator takes care of the setup. You do not need to do anything.
setup.persons.title: Who is part of the household?
setup.persons.body: Every Home Assistant user who takes part becomes a person. You can adjust the names.
setup.accounts.title: Which account belongs to whom?
setup.accounts.body: This is only the default. Budget positions and corrections take precedence. You can assign open accounts later.
setup.payday.title: When is payday?
setup.payday.body: Your month starts with your salary. We looked for the largest regular deposit on your accounts.
setup.payday.none: No suggestion found. Enter the day or leave it empty to use the calendar month.
setup.payday.no_persons: No people yet. This step can wait.
setup.payday.err: The day must be between 1 and 31.
setup.pots.title: Pots from your history
setup.pots.body: This is what you typically spent in recent months. Choose what becomes a pot and adjust the amounts.
setup.pots.empty: Not enough history for suggestions yet. You can add pots later on Start once a few months of data are in.
setup.plan.title: Budget plan
setup.plan.body: The plan records what you set aside: fixed costs and income per person. It is an extra and not needed to start.
setup.plan.import: Got your household spreadsheet? Upload the .xlsx file or paste a Google Sheets link. The import replaces the current plan.
setup.plan.url_hint: The sheet must be shared as “Anyone with the link”. While it is, anyone with the link can read it. You can revoke the sharing after the import.
setup.plan.url_err: Please paste a link to docs.google.com/spreadsheets.
setup.plan.warnings: $n notes from the import – details in the budget plan.
setup.plan.later: You can do this any time. Pots and cycle work without a plan.
setup.notif.title: Notifications
setup.notif.body: Quiet and rare: only exceptions and a weekly overview. Everything can be turned off.
setup.notif.factor: Large means more than this factor times the usual
setup.notif.threshold: Or from this amount in euros (0 = off)
setup.ai.title: AI categorisation
setup.ai.body: For transactions no rule recognises, an AI can suggest the category. Your Home Assistant's own AI is used first.
setup.ai.privacy: Only merchant name and remittance text are sent, never amount, IBAN or date. Without consent everything stays local.
setup.done.title: All set
setup.done.body: This is where you stand. Anything skipped can be done later under Setup.
home.setup.resume_body: Real numbers in a few minutes: people, accounts, payday and pots from your history.
home.setup.member_body: An administrator is setting up the household. Afterwards your numbers show up here.
setup.region.title: Where do you live?
setup.region.body: We only need the state to compare against typical spending in your region. The postcode is optional.
ct.title: Contracts and subscriptions
ct.total_note: Fixed costs from $n contracts and subscriptions
ct.empty: No recurring payments detected yet. Once an item has been booked several times it shows up here.
ct.member_note: You see the contracts that belong to you or the household as an overview.
ct.f.special: Special termination right on a price increase
ct.special_prefilled: Prefilled from the latest payments – please check.
ct.defaults: Usual for $cat: $term months term, renewal by $renewal months, notice period $notice $unit.
rs.title: Reserves for yearly payments
rs.intro: Rare payments spread over the months, so the money is ready when they fall due.
rs.empty: No yearly or quarterly payments detected.
rs.accounts_hint: Mark the accounts that hold reserves.
bm.title: Comparison with the average
bm.error: The comparison could not be loaded.
bm.denied: The comparison is only visible to administrators.
bm.intro: Your planned budget next to official averages. A guide, not a target: location, age and circumstances explain many differences.
bm.no_plan: A budget plan is needed for the comparison.
bm.empty: There is no matching reference value for your plan yet.
bm.diff_same: About the same as the reference
bm.meaning_more: A value above the average often has understandable reasons, such as location or household size.
bm.meaning_less: A value below the average shows some room here. Whether that fits is up to you.
bm.next_housing: Possible next step: look at electricity, gas and internet under "Contracts".
bm.next_other: Possible next step: look at the items in the budget plan.
bm.fallback: National value – no more specific value exists for your region
bm.floor_note: The standard need is the legal minimum, not an average to undercut.
bm.unavailable_note: We deliberately show no value for these areas.
settings.title: People & accounts
settings.intro: Decide who belongs to the household and which account belongs to whom. This is only the default – budget positions and corrections take precedence.
settings.step1: Who is part of the household?
settings.step1_hint: Every Home Assistant user who belongs to the household becomes a person.
settings.step2_hint: Open means not decided yet. Household = shared account.
settings.no_persons: Add at least one person above first.
settings.err_dup: Each name may appear only once.
hh.plan.empty: No plan yet. The setup wizard creates income and cost positions with owners – or takes them over from your spreadsheet.
setup.reload_error: Could not reload the status – showing the last known one.
